text:
Harini (Finance): quick postmortem follow-up re: recurring metering drift -> token overcounts. we split work into 3 lanes: engineering mitigation, billing remediation, and customer comms/support. need firm owners + dates.

Mateo (Eng): i'll own eng. initial RCA points to replayed telemetry without idempotency and a subtle race in the batch-merge window. i'll produce a minimal repro, ship an ingest-side dedupe (canary), and add a nightly regression that replays a small randomized window. ETA repro + canary: 2026-04-14 COB. will add a unit test that simulates out-of-order ACKs.

Zack (Billing): i'll take invoice corrections. ask eng for request_id CSV with token deltas and customer mapping. plan: map -> draft credit memos -> pilot corrections for 30 invoices -> full run. tentative pilot date: 2026-04-18 AM PST.

Fern (Support): support will prep two templates (enterprise detailed + general notice) and an escalation matrix for refund requests. i'll also staff a dedicated inbox during the pilot. need list of enterprise customers from billing.

Harini (Finance): Mateo please paste a short query to extract suspect rows so billing can begin mapping.

Mateo (Eng): quick query (no PI):

```\nSELECT req_id, customer_id, reported_tokens, estimated_tokens, (reported_tokens - estimated_tokens) AS delta\nFROM metering_logs\nWHERE day = '2026-04-13' AND (reported_tokens - estimated_tokens) > 40\nORDER BY delta DESC\nLIMIT 600;\n```
I'll export CSV to s3://incidents/2472009876/affected.csv in ~90m.

AuditBot: file_upload: s3://incidents/2472009876/affected.csv uploaded by @mateo-eng at 2026-04-14T09:14:02Z; rows=389; size=95KB

Zack (Billing): received. quick policy question: for invoices already reconciled/paid do we refund or credit? Harini, what's the policy for this incident?

Harini (Finance): policy decision: refunds only on customer request AND amount > $450; enterprise invoices and invoices > $900 get line-item adjustments. otherwise issue account credits. document in remediation notes and in customer comms.

Fern (Support): drafting templates. will post drafts by 2026-04-15 11:00 PST. will also create an FAQ for the billing portal.

Mateo (Eng): short-term mitigation: 12s ingest dedupe window + metric ingest_duplicate_pct. will add a PD alert if daily duplicate pct > 0.3%. long-term: idempotency keys and safe-replay.

Zack (Billing): mapping complete: ~94 invoices impacted, 25 > $900, estimated adjustment total ~$19,260. will prep credit memos and schedule pilot on 2026-04-18 09:00 PST. posting owner+ETA to remediation tracker shortly.

Harini (Finance): action summary:
- Mateo (Eng): repro, canary dedupe, CI nightly replay test, PD alert (due 2026-04-14 EOD)
- Zack (Billing): invoice mapping, credit memos, pilot corrections (pilot 2026-04-18)
- Fern (Support): comms templates & triage matrix (draft 2026-04-15 11:00)

Mateo (Eng): deployed canary to staging. initial replay shows ~90% reduction in duplicate attribution. pushing to canary cluster for production shadowing next.

AuditBot: remediation_tracker: updated by @harini-finance at 2026-04-14T11:05:00Z; link=https://internal/redwood/remediation/2472009876

Zack (Billing): pilot scheduled. Support please monitor responses and route refunds per policy.

Fern (Support): acknowledged. will escalate refund requests > $450 to Harini and log customer replies in the pilot sheet.

Harini (Finance): one more ask  let's add a weekly metering audit that computes invoice-level token delta ratios and alerts if a model's daily delta_rate > 0.5% for two consecutive weeks. Mateo  can you add a Grafana panel and the alert rule?

Mateo (Eng): yes, will add the dashboard and the alert. posting the alert rule link once live.

Harini (Finance): thanks all. i'll update the tracker and loop in legal if any refunds are requested. please update this thread when tasks complete. :white_check_mark:
